description: Runs a JavaScript regular expression against text and returns every match with its position and capture groups, or the text after replacement. Use it to verify a regex actually works before relying on it.

flags.description: Optional flags: i (ignore case), m (multiline), s (dotall), u (unicode), y (sticky). Global matching is always on.

replace_with.description: Optional replacement string ($1, $<name> supported). If set, returns the replaced text too.

name: regex_test
title: Test a regular expression
